content.hebrew: אַתָּה אֵל מִתְנַשֵּׂא, וְיֹשֵׁב בְּכִסֵּא מַמְלָכָה,
content.transliteration: Atta el mitnassē, veyoshev bekhissē mamlakha,
content.english: You are the uplifted God, seated on the throne of kingship,

content.hebrew: הַמַּצִּיב לְעַמְּךָ, מַעֲרָכָה לִקְרַאת מַעֲרָכָה:
content.transliteration: Hammats’tsiv le‘ammekha, ma‘arakha liḳrat ma‘arakha:
content.english: [You] who have Your people stand, formation facing formation:

content.hebrew: רָאשֵׁיכֶם, שִׁבְטֵיכֶם, זִקְנֵיכֶם – עֵדָה מִימֵי בְרֵאשִׁית נִמְשָׁכָה,
content.transliteration: Rashekhem, shivtekhem, ziḳnekhem – ‘eda mimē vereshit nimshakha,
content.english: Your heads [of] your tribes, your elders [of] the congregation that has been drawn forth since the time of creation,

content.hebrew: נִצְּבוּ כֻלָּם, טַף וְאִשָּׁה, חֹטֵב עֵצִים וְשֹׁאֵב מֵימֵי בְרֵכָה.
content.transliteration: Nits’tsevu khullam, taf ve’ish’sha, ḥotev ‘etsim vesho’ev memē verekha.
content.english: They are all standing, children and women, woodchoppers and drawers of water from pools.

content.hebrew: לַעֲבֹר בִּבְרִית שָׂם לָהֶם עֲרוּכָה,
content.transliteration: La‘avor bivrit sam lahem ‘arukha,
content.english: He gave them a fully drawn-up covenant into which to induct [them],

content.hebrew: לְמַֽעַן הָקִים אוֹתָם לוֹ לְעַם, נַחֲלָה בְרוּכָה.
content.transliteration: Lema‘an haḳim lo le‘am, naḥala verukha.
content.english: In order to establish them as His people, [His] blessed inheritance.

content.hebrew: לְיֶשְׁנוֹ וְלַדֹּרוֹת הַבָּאוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶם, [בְּרִיתוֹ] נִמְשָׁכָה.
content.transliteration: Leyeshno veladdorot habba’ot aḥarehem, berito nimshakha.
content.english: To those who are present, and [also] to the generations to come after them, His covenant extends.

content.hebrew: וַאֲשֶׁר נַפְשׁוֹ בַּיוי נְבוּכָה,
content.transliteration: Va’asher nafsho ba’Adonai nevukha,
content.english: And as for one whose soul is astray regarding Adonai,

content.hebrew: וְהִתְבָּרֵךְ בִּלְבָבוֹ לֵאמֹר: "שָׁלוֹם יִהְיֶה לִּי, בְּלִי פִרְכָה,
content.transliteration: Vehitbarekh bilvavo lemor: “Shalom yihyē li, beli firkha,
content.english: Who blesses themself in their heart, saying, “I will have it well, with nothing broken,

content.hebrew: כִּי בִשְׁרִירוּת לִבִּי אֶתְהַלְּכָה",
content.transliteration: Ki vishrirut libbi et’hallekha”,
content.english: For I will follow the obduracy of my heart,”

content.hebrew: לְמַֽעַן סְפוֹת הָרָוָה עִם הַנִּזְעָכָה.
content.transliteration: Lema‘an sefot harav ‘im hanniz‘akha.
content.english: In order to add the satiated to the thirsty—

content.hebrew: יֶעְשַׁן אַף יוי, וַחֲמָתוֹ בּוֹ נִתָּכָה,
content.transliteration: Ye‘shan af Adonai, vaḥamato bo nittekha,
content.english: Adonai’s wrath will smolder, His rage will be poured out upon them,

content.hebrew: וְהִבְדִּילוֹ יוי לְרָעָה, מֵאֵין אֲרוּכָה,
content.transliteration: Vehivdilo Adonai lera‘a, me’en arukha,
content.english: And Adonai will separate them for irremediable ill,

content.hebrew: כִּי פָנָה מִנְּוַת אוֹרָה אֶל חֲשֵׁכָה.
content.transliteration: Ki fana minnevat ora el ḥashekha.
content.english: For they have turned away from the beauty of light to darkness.

content.hebrew: אַחֲלֵי אֱנוֹשׁ קֶֽשֶׁת תְּעוּדַת דָּתוֹ דְרוּכָה,
content.transliteration: Aḥalē enosh ḳeshet te‘udat dato derukha,
content.english: Happy is the person whose bow is always drawn for the testimony of their Law,

content.hebrew: וְחֶשְׁקָתוֹ לְאֵל עָל תְּמוּכָה,
content.transliteration: Veḥeshḳato le’El ‘al temukha,
content.english: Whose yearning rests on God, the One on high,

content.hebrew: וִימִינוֹ בִּימִין אֵל סְמוּכָה,
content.transliteration: Vimino bimin El semukha,
content.english: Whose right hand is supported by God’s right hand,

content.hebrew: וְתָמִיד לִבּוֹ בַּעֲבֹדָתוֹ כַּמַּֽיִם יִשְׁפְּכָה.
content.transliteration: Vetamid libbo ba‘avodato kammayim yishpekha.
content.english: And who constantly pours out their heart, in service of Him.

content.hebrew: כִּי מִי דוֹמֶה לּוֹ? וְלַיוי הַמְּלוּכָה,
content.transliteration: Ki mi domē lo? Vela’Adonai hammelukha,
content.english: For who is similar to Him? To Adonai is the kingship!

content.hebrew: וּמְלַאכְתּוֹ בֶּאֱמֶת הִיא הַמְּלָאכָה –
content.transliteration: Umelakhto be’emet hi hammelakha –
content.english: His activity is what is truly activity—

content.hebrew: מַעֲלֶה וּמוֹרִיד, וּבְיָדוֹ הַמַּסֵּכָה הַנְּסוּכָה,
content.transliteration: Ma‘alē umorid, uvyado hammassekha hannesukha,
content.english: He raises up and brings down, and in His hand is the blanket spread out,

content.hebrew: קהל: וּמִי כָמֹֽהוּ, מְרוֹמַם עַל כָּל־תְּהִלָּה וּבְרָכָה?
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Umi khamohu, meromam ‘al kol tehilla uverakha?
content.english: Cong. And who is like Him, lofty over all blessing and praise?

content.hebrew: חזן: כִּ֥י מִי־אֵ֖ל מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יו֑י וּמִ֥י צ֖וּר מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ: (שמואל ב ככ:לב)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Ki mi el mibbal‘adē Adonai umi tsur mibbal‘adē elohenu:
content.english: Cantor. For who is God besides Adonai, and who is a rock besides our God? (2 Sam.22:32)

content.hebrew: כִּ֤י מִ֣י אֱ֭לוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יו֑י וּמִי־צ֝֗וּר זוּלָתִ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ: (תהלים יח:לב)
content.transliteration: Ki mi Elo’ah mibbal‘adē Adonai umi tsur zulati elohenu:
content.english: For who is God besides Adonai, and who is a rock other than our God? (Ps. 18:32)

content.hebrew: אֵֽין־קָד֥וֹשׁ כַּיו֖י כִּי־אֵ֣ין בִּלְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאֵ֥ין צ֖וּר כֵּֽאלֹהֵֽינוּ: (שמואל א ב:ב)
content.transliteration: En ḳadosh ka’Adonai ki en biltekha ve’en tsur kelohenu:
content.english: There is none holy like Adonai, for there is none besides You; and there is no rock like our God. (1 Sam. 2:2)

content.hebrew: קהל: וְאַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: (תהלים כב:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ve’atta ḳadosh yoshev tehillot Yisra’el:
content.english: Congregation: And You are holy, enthroned on Israel’s praises. (Ps. 22:4)
